question:
Two hydrogen-like ions $X^{(Z_X-1)+}$ and $Y^{(Z_Y-1)+}$ (nuclei assumed infinitely heavy) emit photons due to electronic transitions.

A photon emitted in the transition $n=2\to 1$ of ion $X^{(Z_X-1)+}$ has the **same wavelength** as a photon emitted in the transition $n=4\to 2$ of ion $Y^{(Z_Y-1)+}$.

Using the hydrogen-like energy level formula
$$E_n=-\frac{13.6\,Z^2}{n^2}\,\text{eV},$$
find the pair $(Z_X, Z_Y)$.

(Assume $Z_X$ and $Z_Y$ are positive integers and choose the option that satisfies the coincidence condition.)
